text:
alex_garcia: Paging — edge-alert: signature-entropy spike on Authorization headers from edge-proxy cluster. Honeypot saw thousands of short-lived bearer-like strings. @oncall_ryan can you triage? :eyes:

sre_bot: [ALERT] auth-anomaly-edge (edge-proxy-03) severity: elevated. sample_entropy: 7.9, requests: 6,120 in 12m. src IP clusters: 34.120.*/16, 3.14.*/16.

maria_kovacs: I pulled the access logs from proxy-03 — seeing truncated bearer tokens being forwarded to our ELK (access.log forwarding). Masking seems to be failing on the syslog -> forwarder pipeline. Example log line (sanitized): 
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:07Z] "GET /v1/generate" 200 - "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ...==\n"
```

oncall_ryan: Thanks. I'm taking incident lead. Marking P1 for now until we confirm customer impact. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop log-forwarder on edge-proxy group, 2) block offending IP CIDRs at edge WAF, 3) identify affected service principals and rotate keys.

elaine_w: Starting svcacct rotation for the list I'm pulling now. I'll run targeted KMS rotate for svc-auth-prod, svc-metrics, svc-indexer first. ETA ~18-22m. I'll publish rotation IDs as they complete. :lock:

maria_kovacs: Executing stop: `ssh edge-proxy-03 -- sudo systemctl stop log-forwarder` — confirmed stop on nodes: edge-proxy-01, -02, -03. Forwarding pipeline paused.

oncall_ryan: WAF rules applied: blocked 34.120.0.0/16 and 3.14.0.0/16 at edge-acl. Added temporary rate limit 10r/s per src. Monitor for collateral. :thumbsup:

maria_kovacs: Quick grep across recent rotated S3 buckets: `aws s3 cp s3://edge-logs/proxy/2026-03-17/ - | grep -i "authorization"` — found ~45 lines with partial token fragments in staging and one in prod-archive S3 prefix. Prod object `prod-archive/access/2026-03-17T09:11:00.log` contains a few masked but recoverable fragments.

elaine_w: Rotations in progress: svc-auth-prod -> rotation id rot_20260317_01 (in-flight), svc-indexer -> rot_20260317_02 (done), svc-metrics queued. I'm also triggering `authctl revoke-credentials --service svc-indexer --all-sessions` for immediate session revoke.

oncall_ryan: Can security_jon own customer impact assessment + legal notification triage? If any production service tokens were exfiltrated we need to prepare PSAT/Legal notif.

security_jon: On it. I'm enumerating which customers use svc-indexer/svc-auth-prod. Running `SELECT customer_id FROM service_usage WHERE service IN (\"svc-indexer\",\"svc-auth-prod\") AND last_seen > '2026-03-16'` and will flag high-risk tenants. Also pulling retention windows for prod-archive S3.

maria_kovacs: Confirmed: rotated forwarder config had a regex that accidentally stripped last 6 chars instead of replacing with [MASK]. I'll push a hotfix to the forwarder to re-mask and add unit tests after containment. For now forwarder is stopped.

oncall_ryan: Good. Next: deploy temporary token acceptance toggle on auth gateway to ignore legacy tokens (those matching short-length entropy). Patch pushed to canary, rolling to 10% now. Command: `kubectl patch deployment auth-gateway -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"edge/temp-token-filter":"true"}}}}}'`

elaine_w: Rotation status update: rot_20260317_02 completed for svc-indexer, new creds issued and deployed. svc-auth-prod rotation succeeded for auth backend; propagating to consumers. svc-metrics rotation pending. Revoke commands for sessions sent.

security_jon: Customer impact: initial mapping shows 3 enterprise customers (cust-718, cust-912, cust-431) had recent indexer calls within window and may have session tokens briefly present in logs. Recommending outreach: notify security contact with guidance to rotate any customer-managed keys if they surface tokens; we'll offer assisted rotation. Legal brief drafted in #legal for review.

maria_kovacs: S3 ops: removed public-read perms on prod-archive prefix, set object ACLs to private, and initiated expedited retention purge for affected objects (lifecycle delete tag `incident_3789012345`). Also disabled any downstream log-forwarder lambdas.

oncall_ryan: Monitoring: set alert `auth-token-entropy` to suppress noisy duplicates and create a follow-up metric for token-leakage-lines. Also creating a short-term dashboard for traces that contain "Authorization:" in plain text across our pipelines.

elaine_w: svc-metrics rotation done. All three affected services rotated + sessions revoked. Verifying consumers reconnected OK. No auth failures reported on canary.

security_jon: We have no evidence of external exfil beyond the log-forwarder; WAF blocks appear to have reduced the anomalous traffic to background noise. Customer notif list assembled and legal approves contacting 3 customers with recommended steps.

oncall_ryan: Thanks team. Next actions: 1) reopen forwarder only after masking fix + tests, 2) run full s3 object scan for 'Authorization' strings (job queued), 3) schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:30 PT — owner: maria_kovacs.

maria_kovacs: Postmortem owner acked. I'll attach timelines and a remediation checklist (fix forwarder, add masking unit tests, harden ELK ingest pipelines, add additional WAF rules).

sre_bot: [RESOLUTION] incident 3789012345: edge-auth-signature-entropy-triage — mitigations applied, forwarder stopped, rotations completed, no confirmed customer data exfil beyond logs. Monitoring window 4h.

oncall_ryan: Closing the live bridge for now. Leave monitoring alert active for 4h and then lower severity if clean. Good work everyone. :fire_engine:
